label: eye level
text: camera at the subject's eye level
note: The neutral. Not a choice unless stated against another.

label: high angle
text: camera above the subject, looking down

label: low angle
text: camera below the subject, looking up

label: overhead
text: camera directly above, looking straight down

label: aerial
text: camera high above the scene, moving
note: Almost always carries motion; rarely legal as a static.

label: dutch angle
note: A roll, not a rotation over time. Static frame with a tilted horizon.

label: profile
text: camera at ninety degrees to the subject's facing

label: frontal
text: camera square to the subject's facing

label: three-quarter
text: camera at forty-five degrees to the subject's facing
